description: This file defines the 'ProjectAdmin' entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It maps the 'ohrm_project_admin' database table and establishes relationships to 'Project' and 'Employee' entities as a composite primary key, representing project administrator assignments.

classes.name: ProjectAdmin
classes.description: Entity class representing a project administrator mapping, with references to a specific Project and Employee, forming a composite primary key.
